svg.title: Figure 1D. Coordination motifs represented by CoordRep
svg.desc: Replaceable chemistry-first layout with four authentic coordination examples: ATIZEK, VOBZER, POXVEH, and XUMMID. The groups named DRAWING_* may be replaced with ChemDraw vector artwork without moving the text.
svg.metadata: The three molecular drawings are embedded 1000 by 800 pixel CSD DiagramGenerator references for manual replacement with ChemDraw vector structures. XUMMID is an embedded vector drawing. All labels and dividers are editable SVG text and paths.
svg.text: Complete annotated CoordRep strings are shown in Box 1.
